pr.title: chore(repo): remove genetic agent and taskmaster surfaces
pr.body:
## Summary
- remove active Genetic Agent runtime and CLI wiring while preserving archive evidence
- remove active Taskmaster and Task-Master-AI service, MCP, PM, script, config, test, and docs surfaces
- document validation and PR queue follow-up analysis

## Validation
- Task Packet JSON/schema validation
- focused CLI and PM tests
- active-reference scan
- compileall, diff check, and pre-commit where available

## PR queue follow-up
After this cleanup lands, refresh #584, Dependabot #582/#583, and pack-branch PRs #572/#573 against the new main before merging.
